title: Seed selection and conditional CMB limits on Model 1

source_evidence.locator: Secs.2.1-2.2 Eqs.(2.1)-(2.6); Secs.4.1-4.3 Eqs.(4.3)-(4.10), Fig. 4; Sec.5 and Table 1; Sec.6.1 Eq.(6.9), Appendix B definition Hcal=aH and Eq.(B.13); Appendix A Method 3

assumptions: Published finite seed sets, nuisance/prior choices and source likelihood implementation.
Dark-energy perturbations switched off; precomputed histories rescaled/interpolated through separately treated eras.

Main-text seed weights use marginal likelihoods estimated by a harmonic mean; Appendix A Method 3 instead describes equal averaging of normalized fixed-seed posteriors. Exact implemented weighting and estimator stability are unresolved.
predictions: Some selected supernova histories fit well while the published Model 1 CMB implementation fits worse than LambdaCDM. This is a reported conditional fit, not a family-wide exclusion.
Suppression near last scattering and flexible background splines are distinct prescriptions; a selected best seed is not global model evidence.

The printed Sec.4.2 chi2<1060 subset conflicts with its best fit 1481.9; retain the threshold as unresolved. Sec.7 summary percentages are not reconciled with Sec.4.1 exact counts and are not used as probabilities.

The alleged visibility-width inconsistency is a reader error: Appendix B uses Hcal=aH, so sigma_g≈z_star/(10^4 Hcal_star)=z_star(1+z_star)/(10^4 H_star)≈z_star^2/(10^4 H_star), matching Eq.(6.9) in the stated high-redshift approximation.

Source best CMB statistic 2495.6 versus about 2339.0 for its LambdaCDM likelihood; suppression branches give 2360.5/2358.5. These are optimized finite-seed results conditional on disabled DE perturbations and the stated background approximations, not global model evidence.
qualification: Source proposal or reported conditional test only; no independent reproduction, observational reassessment or scientific qualification.
